title: Punjab Chief Minister Sets 2027 Deadline for Water Plants
excerpt: Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif has established a June 2027 deadline to finish thousands of water filtration plants.
body_html: Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif has established a completion deadline for a major water infrastructure project in the region. According to the announcement, a total of 5,734 water filtration plants are scheduled to be finished across the province by June 2027.
